༄༅/ /bde mgon gyi las rim gsal byed sgron me'i lhan thabs bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lhar/ /gus btud bde ma

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bde mgon gyi las rim gsal byed sgron me'i lhan thabs bsnyen sgrub kyi man ngag bzhugs so//bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lhar// gus btud bde mgon

rje kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub pa'i thabs// las rim gsal byed sgron me yi// lhan thabs bsnyen sgrub man ngag bri// ma hā kā lā'i las rim gyi mchod pa phul ba'i mjug bstod pa'i snga rol der/ bsnyen sgrub sbrag mar nyams su blang ba ni/ bgrang phreng rab skyes pa grir shi ba'i thod pa/ 'bring lung thang*/ tha ma ru rak+sha'am tsher ma can gyi shing las byas pa brgya phrag mdo 'dzin dang bcas pa bskyil te/ khaṇ+ḍa ro he sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs| stong pa'i ngang las bgrang phreng gi mdo 'dzin dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes yab yum dang*/ phreng rdog rnams ye shes mgon por gsal ba/ lhan skyes yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi bab pas mgon po thams cad tshim zhing mnyes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐| brgya phrag bzla/ slar mdo 'dzin lhan skyes yab yum yongs su gyur pa las/ ye shes mgon po yum gtum pa'i dbang phyug ma dang sbyor ba/ phreng rdog gi mgon po rnams yongs su gyur pa las mi mgo rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa re rer gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ka wu wa huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brgya phrag bzlas rjes/ nag po chen po yab yum yongs su gyur pa las mdo 'dzin chos sku'i mchod rten gyi rnam par gyur par bsam/ bgrang phreng byin rlabs bsdus pa byed na mdud 'dzin bla ma dang dbyer med pa phreng rdog rnams mgon po'i sku brgya rtsa brgyad du bsam yi ge gsum brgya phrag gcig bzlas des chog pa yin/ bsnyen sgrub sbrags pa'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag gi mthar/ g.yon skor du oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ kyis bskor ba/ mdun bskyed ma hā kā lā'i thugs kar pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag gsal zhing brtan pa'i tha mar/ g.yon skor du rtsa ba'i snying po dang*/

nye snying dang*/ 'gugs pa dang*/ gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang*/ srog gi snying po rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ las mgon gsum/ seng gdong yum/ mkha' 'gro ma brgyad rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su/ las mgon gsum la hūm̐ mthing nag re re/ seng gdong la hrīḥmathing nag dang*/ yum la maṃ smug nag /gzhan mkha' 'gro brgyad sogs mo rgyud thams cad kyis thugs kar bh+yoḥmathing nag dang*/ pho rgyud thams cad kyi thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba re re'i mthar rang rang gi sngags kyis g.yon skor du bskor bar gyur pa ra bsam/ gtso bo'i bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags ni/ bdag he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer rnams spros pa mgon po'i thugs kar zhugs/ de nyid kyi sngags phreng rnams la 'dres/ lan gsum bskor te/ sngon bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar dam bcas pa las phyi rabs kyi sgrub pa po rnams kyi phrin las sgrub pa thugs dam du bzhes pa mi bsnyel pa'i rgyud bskul/ slar mgon po'i zhal nas thon/ bdag he ru kar gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim pa'i tshe/ bdag gang 'dod pa'i phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i dngos grub dang srog snying skad cig la 'bul bar gyur par dmigs te/ zhes pa ni spyir btang la/ bye brag ni zhi ba la sngags kyi 'od zer dkar pos gang zhi bar 'dod pa rnams zhi bar byas pa dang*/ rgyas pa la sngags kyi 'od zer ser pos gang rgyas par 'dod pa de rgyas par byas pa dang*/ dbang la sngags kyi 'od zer dmar pos gang dbang du bya bar 'dod pa de 'dus pa dang*/ drag po la sngags kyi 'od zer nag pos dgra bgegs sogs gang yin de tshar gcod par bsam la/ 'di ni bsdus pa'o// rgyas par 'dod na 'gro mgon phag grus mdzad pa'i thod nag gi be'u bum gyi las bzhi'i dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor ltar byas na legs pa yin no| | oṃ ma hā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭa/

rtsa ba'i snying po 'bru bdun pa'o// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ nye snying 'bru dgu pa'o// oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ myur du 'gugs pa'i snying po yi ge 'bru bcu pa'o// oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa ma hā kā lā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ brtan par bzhugs shing gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i snying po 'bru bcu gsum pa'o/ / oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa pa ma hā kā lā ya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ srog gi snying po ches zab pa 'bru bco lnga pa'o| |de ltar sngags gzhan rnams ci nus bzla zhing*/ gtso bo 'bru bco lnga pa bzla ba yin no// sngags la dun ya dang ka li ya sogs 'ju+ug pa skabs gzhan du'o// de yang sngags gang bzla ba de bde mchog yin na yig bdun la btags na 'jam bkra shis la ma btags na rtsub la las myur ba yin/ chos skyong gi sngags rnams kyang rim pas gong ma gong ma la bsnyen pa mang du song rim bzhin rim pas 'og ma rnams btags nas bzla ba grub chen mgar dam pa'i bzhed pa'o/ /de rjes 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe| bdag he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi ye shes mgon po'i thugs kar phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pa 'khor thams cad kyi snying ga'i sa bon sngags phreng la phog /thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te bdag mdun gyi lhas gang bsgo ba'i phrin las thams cad da lta nyid du sgrub par gyur par dmigs la/ oṃ ma hā kā lā su tri ya ma du dzaḥ bya rog gdong gsum gyi snying po'o// oṃ ma hā kā lā trak+shad dzaḥ bya gdong gsum gyi nye snying ngo*// oṃ ma hā kā lā gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa/ bya rog gsum gyi srog sngags so/ */ oṃ ma hā kā lā singha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ seng gdong ngo*// oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā lī kā lī ma hā kā lī hūm̐ bh+yoḥdzaḥ oṃ ki ne shwa ri snying kha raka tsit+ta srog dung dung dun dun breng breng dzaḥdzaḥ

oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī rū pi ṇī hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum rnams so// sngags 'di yum rnams kyi spyi khyab yin 'dug / oṃ ghid+da s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ bya rgod gdong ma'o// oṃ ga ru ḍa s+yai+ai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khyung gdong ma'o// oṃ ka kā s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ khwa gdong ma'o// oṃ ul+lu ka s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'ug gdong ma'o// oṃ bā rā ha s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ phag gdong ma'o// oṃ shwa na s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ khyi gdong ma'o// oṃ shriṃ gā la s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ spyang gdong ma'o// oṃ byā gh+ra s+yai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ stag gdong ma'o// oṃ ma hā kā lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma mo bye ba sogs mo rgyud thams cad do// oṃ karma ma hā kā lā hūm̐ phaṭa/ nag po stong sde sogs pho rgyud thams cad do// de ltar 'khor gyi sngags rnams rim bzhin bzla'o// de rjes gtso 'khor thun mong du las 'chol ba'i sngags ring ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma kā lo a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra tidz+nyā sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭāṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ bhan+dha bhan+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐| zhes pa las 'chol gyi skabs yin na ci mang bzla ba gal che'o// de ltar nyin mtshan thun bzhi'am/ drug tu mi tshig gis bar ma chod cing ting nge 'dzin gsal bas sngags la lhag chad med par bzla ba shin tu gal che'o// thun mtshams rnams su gtor ma 'bul zhing*/ mchod bstod dang*/ tshogs mchod/ bskang bshags/ mnga' gsol sogs gzhung ltar 'bad cing las 'chol gyi bsnyen sgrub yin na thugs dam bskul ba sogs kyang bya'o// de ltar bsnyen cing bsgrubs pas rtags kyi khyad par spyir mang yang*| bye brag nges pa'i rtags ni/ rang gi bla mas dngos grub ster ba ni ye shes pa'i rtags/

pha'am spun la sogs pas grogs byed pa ni bya rog gdong gi rtags/ ma'am sring mo la sogs pas bza' btung ster ba ni yum gyi rtags/ bran g.yog la sogs pas ci dgos sgrub pa ni seng gdong gi rtags/ kun tshang bar byung na thams cad kyi rtags yin/ spyir mi 'gyur nges pa'i rtags ni bya rog /zlog rtags nges pa ni bya rog mi 'khor ba yin/ rtags ma byung ba'am byung yang mi mnyes pa'i mtshan ma ston na dam tshig bshags sdom bya/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blang*/ gtor ma 'bung bskyed la 'bul/ bskang brgyad 'don/ bskang bshags bya/ gzhan yang nges pa'i rtags la/ dngos nyams gang rung gtor ma'i steng du bya rog gi tshang bca' ba/ bya rog bab pa dang lding ba/ rmi lam du mi nag po dang*/ bud med kyi tshogs dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan gyi tshogs la sogs pa dpag tu med pa 'byung*/ rab dngos su zhal mthong ba dang*/ 'bring rmi lam du bya nag dang sngags nag sgrub khang steng du 'dug pa dang*/ gtor ma za ba dang*/ las ran zer ba dang*/ gtor ma'i steng du bya rog spung spung byed pa 'ong*/ tha ma ni rmi lam du sgrub khang steng du bya rog gi tshogs bab pa dang*/ dngos su gtor ma'i steng du chags pa sogs ni bsnyen sgrub kyi rtags yin no// 'gyang pa'i rtags ni mi nag po khros nas rgyab ston pa dang*/ bsnyen sgrub kyis bying ba'am rgod pa dang*/ bya rog gis gtor ma mi len pa sogs byung na/ sngar brten ma btsugs na gzugs/ dus bzhir mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul/ bstod cing gsol ba gdab/ thugs dam bskang zhing bzlas pa la 'bad do// bzlog pa'i rtags ni/ snying mi dga'/ ngu snying 'dod/ 'jigs nas sgrub khang du sdod mi 'dod/ rmi lam du bya rog gi tshogs 'thab pa dang*/ mi nag khros nas bdag la rdeg pa dang*/ mtshon cha'i char 'bab pa/ lug nag dang rta nag dang g.yag nag 'thab pa sogs rmis na bla ma dang dkon mchog la mchod pa 'bul/

bskang mdos dang tshogs gtor bya/ rkang brgyad sgra ma chad par zhag gsum sogs rgyun 'dzugs/ gzungs chog bya/ des kyang 'jam du ma song na/ bde mchog yig bdun la yi ge bco lnga pa dang las mgon gyi sngags sbrel nas bzla'o// gzhan yang ye shes pa'i sngags mthar bzhi snying zlog sbrel dang gtor ma rdab pa dang*/ gzugs la chu tshan dbab pa dang*| tsha ba gsum rdeg pa sogs gzhung dang man ngag bla ma'i zhal shes ltar lag tu blang ba yin no// 'di rnams ni gtso bo bsnyen sgrub sbrags ma'i lugs mdor bsdus pa yin la/ las sbyor gyi dmigs pa dang sngags sogs ni gzhung dang man ngag tu blta bar bya zhing*/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor so sor nyams su blang ba ni gzhung dang*/ 'grel pa dang*/ gces brgyad gzhung 'grel/ srog bzhi'i zhal gdams rtsa 'grel/ sku rags 'khor lo gcig ma dang*/ gnyis ma/ gsum ma/ bzhi ma/ lnga ma la sogs dang*| thod nag gi bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi be'u bum gsum ma sogs dang*/ de rnams kyi gzhung 'grel zhal gdams man ngag zin bris sogs shin tu mang ba'i phyir 'dir ma bris/ de dag so sor slob dpon mnyes pa'i gsung gi gsang ba las rtogs par byos shig /ces pa'ang rang lugs kyi mgon po'i las rim gsal bar byed pa'i sgron mer bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags dang*/ dmigs pa gab pa dag /las can skal ldan rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa kho nas/ 'bri gung pa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pas/ ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gzhung sgrub chos sdings pas mdzad pa dang*/ dpal rga los dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du mgon po zhal gzigs nas gnang ba'i gsang sgrub dang*/ sngags kyi dag byed dang*/ mgon po tshal lugs kyi be'u bum/ slob dpon spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'i mgon po mkha' 'gro brgyad skor gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ dpal phag mo gru pas mdzad pa'i thod nag gi bsnyen pa'i be'u bum rnams nas legs par bsdus te/

chu mo lug lo khrums stod kyi zla ba'i dmar po dga' ba gnyis pa la/ pho brang rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa shin tu khungs dag pa'i gnas su zung zhig /mdun bskyed bsdu ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes sems dpa' de yar phyung nas rten la bstim pa'am/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i 'khor du bzhugs par bsam/ dam tshig sems dpa' de slar yang sa bon hūm̐ de nyid du bsgyur nas bdag nyid dpal he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur par dmigs pa ni man ngag dam pa'o zhes grub chen mgar dam pas gsungs so| |'di shin tu zab pas gzhan la sbos shig/ //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /yang bsnyen sgrub gsol ka sogs kyi gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma gtsang sa'am mgon po gnas pa'i phyogs su khyer te bdud rtsi bran/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs shing chos skyong 'khor bcas la 'bul tshig 'di skad do// hūm̐ */ chos skyong mgon po 'khor bcas kun// chos kyi dbyings na bzhugs pa dang*// sprul pa phyogs mtshams steng 'og gi// sa dang bar snang khyab pa la// ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod gtor 'di// ting 'dzin sngags kyis byin brlabs te// mgon po 'khor bcas mnyes phyir 'bul// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// rnal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa yi// lam gyi 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// bar chad ma lus zhi bar mdzod// ces pas gtor ma gshegs/ zhes pa mgon po'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi chog bsgrigs bdud las rnam rgyal zhes bya ba rga lo'i gsung phag grus bkod pa las/ rin chen bzang po bsdus par 'dug go// ༈ /yang mgon po lha mang gi gtor chog phrin las myur mgyogs kyi lhan thabs gtor skyong mjug tu/ sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru// khas blangs ji bzhin thub bstan dang*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu rjes skyong bar// zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar// brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la| |bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod//
ces 'dug pa 'di gong ma'i zhi bar mdzod kyi mjug tu btags na/ 'phral du thun gtor zor mi byed par thog steng du 'bul ba bya seng gi bskul las 'di legs pa 'dra bsam nas bris pa yin no// //maṅga laṃ//
